message.content:
LiHua, in his conversation with ChaeSong-hwa, mentions that due to the ongoing garden renovation project, he has had to temporarily relocate his work to the café. This decision was made to escape the noise and distractions caused by the renovation, allowing him to maintain focus on his work environment. Both characters agree on the need for this temporary arrangement until the renovations are completed, indicating that the café serves as a suitable alternative workspace during the period of construction in their usual location.

---

The café's quieter setting acts as a conducive backdrop for LiHua's work, ensuring continuity in his daily activities despite the vicissitudes of the home environment at the time.
